title: dynamicCSTR operation
description: The well-stirred tank of choupoCtrl / choupoSemiContinuous: a holdup with mole balances and an energy equation integrated in time. The feed is the `inlet {}` block and the starting state the `initial {}` block of the unit; this `operation` block holds the heat-transfer jacket and the vessel's declarations. A jacket is `UA` (W/K) against `T_jacket` (K): with no UA the vessel is adiabatic. T_jacket may be driven at run time by a controller whose actuator names it.

UA.title: Jacket conductance
UA.description: Overall heat-transfer coefficient times jacket area, U*A, in W/K (raw SI). Heat to the holdup is UA (T_jacket - T). Absent or 0 = no jacket, an adiabatic vessel. Under `UAScaling wetted` on a variable-volume vessel it is the value at the full level.

T_jacket.title: Jacket temperature
T_jacket.description: The jacket's fluid temperature. Defaults to the initial temperature of the holdup (no heat flows). A controller's actuator (`mv T_jacket`) overwrites it every step.

catalystLoading.title: Catalyst loading
catalystLoading.description: Catalyst mass per volume of the holdup, kg/m3 (raw SI), multiplying a catalytic rate law's per-kg rate. Defaults to 0.

UAScaling.title: How UA follows the level
UAScaling.description: Variable-volume vessels only. `wetted` (default) scales UA by the wetted area A_w(h)/A_w(H); `fixed` keeps UA constant whatever the level.

volumeMode.title: Volume mode
volumeMode.description: `constant` (default) is the fixed-volume vessel; `variable` lets the level integrate and needs `geometry {}` and `outflow {}`.

energy.title: Energy declaration
energy.description: `isothermal` holds T at its initial value (refused with a reaction, which would need a duty this unit does not compute). Omit it for the energy equation the unit chooses by probing.

geometry.title: Vessel geometry
geometry.description: The vertical cylinder of a variable-volume vessel (volumeMode variable).

outflow.title: Outflow
outflow.description: The declared outflow of a variable-volume vessel: `mode flow` with `F`, or `mode valve` with `opening` and a `valve {}` block.
